assumptions.assumption: The observed NtOpenSemaphore request belongs to the selected BaseNamedObjects namespace.
assumptions.basis: Read-only observer captured RootDirectory=0x70 and the Local-prefixed name; earlier directory captures identify this root.
assumptions.stress_test: Root-relative Local and Global links, wrong-type roots, absolute/root combinations, case flags.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Native create/open captures contradict same-name identity or captured root object identity.

assumptions.assumption: One native ARM64 kernel can supply evidence for its ARM64, x64 compatibility and WoW64 ABI profiles.
assumptions.basis: Four prior producer profiles ran on Windows 10.0.29683 with per-module identities.
assumptions.dependent_result: Host-specific fault ordering; no cross-kernel universality claim.
assumptions.stress_test: Capture all four profiles independently, including x86 LAA.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Profile-dependent statuses, writes, handle counts, or compiled ABI differ.

assumptions.assumption: Parent Windows source inputs can be reused immutably after verifying their exact hashes.
assumptions.basis: Completed native single-wait source epoch4 manifest and terminal gate records.
assumptions.dependent_result: Native semaphore materialization and warmed Cargo targets.
assumptions.stress_test: Verify all parent files before linking and all new files after extraction, with changed paths separated.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Any before/after parent hash mismatch or unexpected active preceding gate.

assumptions.assumption: The four incoming C API commits leave validated core inputs unchanged.
assumptions.basis: Complete epoch1/epoch2 hashes differ only on eleven capi paths; core/tests have no capi source references, root has no build script.
assumptions.dependent_result: Retention of full epoch1 core/Windows integration results while rebuilding the C API and owning consumers.
assumptions.stress_test: C API1.14 tests and all-target checks on all three hosts; actual new carriers before/after C++ validation.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Any changed non-CAPI input, added core dependency on capi, or mismatched owning core/consumer result.
